source_title: Call of Duty: MW4 Update is Officially Adding Wager Matches
source_excerpt:
Alongside the Season 1 update for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on November 6, Infinity Ward is planning to add a limited-time Wager Match Event, which also includes exclusive unlocks and rewards. It's been a strong start for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , thanks in large part to positive word of mouth from players, especially those who were able to play the Campaign and DMZ during Early Access, as well as extremely strong reviews from critics.
While not perfect, most fans seem to be more than pleased with Modern Warfare 4 and the content it has on offer. Despite many still not thrilled by Modern Warfare 4 's use of skill-based matchmaking and the higher-than-expected time-to-kill, it hasn't prevented the general consensus of the game from remaining very positive. Not only that, the Call of Duty franchise is one that continues to iterate and evolve over time, so fans can certainly expect to see updates and patches that tweak the core experience and likely address those two big issues. In the meantime, with Season 1 right around the corner, fans don't have to wait too much longer for new content.
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Wager Match Event Details
As part of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 's Season 1 reveal event , Infinity Ward also confirmed the arrival of Wager Matches. As part of the revealed roadmap of content, Season 1 adds a new Wager Match Event across multiple modes within Modern Warfare 4 , including DMZ, Warzone, and Gunfight. Essentially, players will be able to complete challenges as well as enter the Gauntlet 1v1 Gunfight playlist to earn trophies, which also serve as the currency for this event. Specifically, players will need to wager their trophies before the Gunfight match begins, with the winner staying on. Winning multiple matches will claim the wagered reward.
Naturally, all of that effort will be rewarded. There will be Mastery Rewards available to chase, including Operator Skins, Blueprints, Weapon Camos, and new Apex Attachments for Modern Warfare 4 players. In fact, for those that are able to make it into the Top 3, they'll be eligible to compete for extra rewards as well. Some rewards for this event include the highly requested Kastov 762 Assault Rifle Apex Attachment and Hyeon Auto Apex Attachment.
Wager matches are just the beginning of what Season 1 has on offer. In addition to new maps, weapons, and game modes, the DMZ is also evolving. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 's DMZ mode has been a major bright spot for many players and once Season 1 arrives, players will be able to explore a new location called X01, featuring underground labs, massive cargo bays, and other facilities to explore. Players should expect stronger enemies here as well as new orders and rewards to earn.
Season 1 will also have an associated game update with it as well, and while Infinity Ward has not provided the specific patch notes as yet, the game has already begun a number of weapon balancing efforts. Patch notes for the Modern Warfare 4 October 28 update have confirmed buffs for 9 weapons including the M4, Kastov 726, ISO Nightshade, and Patriot XMR. On the other hand, 4 weapons have seen some nerfs to bring them more in line with the other available guns. The Han 86, Oden, APOC-338, and FiNN LMG have all been weakened through reducing damage range and removing some damage multipliers.
